notes: P22b3ba7c9c G4. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Ajani, Inspiring Leader, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' The probe board has no Ajani, so its search never finds anything. One Ajani is in seat 0's library and one in its graveyard. Seat 0 casts the Griffin, takes the may (fire), searches both zones (option 0) and picks the library copy: exactly one card is found (a card, not two), it goes to seat 0's hand, the graveyard copy stays. The library keeps its six other cards; their order after the mandated shuffle is unknown (CR 701.21: '*').
